svg.aria-label: Keyboard one, from the lesson: B3 and F4, five letters, six semitones, a diminished fifth, tritone colour #5366A0. Keyboard two, from the Palette card: C4 and F♯4, four letters, six semitones, written as an augmented fourth, the same tritone colour. Same colour and same Plogger bracket [6].
svg.title: The tritone family: B3–F4 beside the Palette card C4–F♯4

g.text: On the Palette card: C4 + F♯4
See Palette card 6 (#ip-06) on the live
How to read this graphic: Compare the two
keyboards. The key colour and the chip are
identical because both pairs are six
semitones. The note names differ because the
pairs sit in different places and are spelled
with different letters. The Palette page
(card 6) shows the second; this lesson works
